name: Vuena Assets MCP – 76 CC0 low-poly 3D models (GLB)
summary: Free MCP server plus direct URLs for 76 CC0 low-poly 3D models as self-contained GLB files (14 rigged with animation clips): characters, animals, toy cars, Halloween/winter props, PSX-style horror props and store/factory/apartment items. Coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor…) can search and pull models straight into a game project; browser games can load the GLBs directly (CORS open).

access.price: $0; optional paid full packs on itch.io
access.notes: Models are free samples of Vuena's paid itch.io packs. Generated procedurally by code written with AI assistance (no AI image/3D generators per the publisher). No credit needed.

procedure: Browse the models at https://vuena-assets.test-games.workers.dev/ (catalog.json lists every GLB and preview URL).
Or add the hosted MCP to your agent: `claude mcp add --transport http vuena-assets https://vuena-assets.test-games.workers.dev/mcp`.
For local saving into a project folder, run the stdio server: `npx -y vuena-assets-mcp` and call download_asset.
FBX versions with textures are in the free Vuena Free Mega Starter download on itch.io (name your own price).

verdict.why: Genuine CC0 GLB set with open direct URLs and an agent-friendly MCP; license stated in repo, catalog.json and itch page. Small (76 models), stylized/procedural, and a funnel to paid packs; brand new (0 stars).
